newsitem.title: USA: American Business to sell Vanier unit.
newsitem.headline: American Business to sell Vanier unit.

text.p: American Business Products Inc said on Tuesday that it has signed a tentative deal to sell its Vanier Graphics subsidiary to Reynolds and Reynolds Co.
Vanier, which had $150 million in 1995 sales, is a leading national business forms manufacturer and provider of related services that include forms management and workflow analysis.
The transaction is subject to various conditions including completion of Reynolds' due diligence process, and is expected to close in late December. Details of the proposed sale were not released.
